prompt: What was the official retail price per liter (in VND, inclusive of VAT and environmental tax) of RON 92-III gasoline on April 24, 2025, according to PetroVietnam Oil Corporation (PVOIL)?
answer: According to PVOIL, the official retail price was **19,230 VND per liter** (including VAT and environmental tax) on April 24, 2025.
